name: First-Depositor ERC4626 Share Inflation Recipe
description: Exploit sequence exploiting rounding down in convertToShares by front-running initial deposit with 1 wei mint followed by large donation.

attack_steps.action: Attacker calls deposit(1 wei) to mint 1 share when totalSupply is 0.
Attacker transfers huge amount of underlying asset directly to vault.
attack_steps.expected_state_delta: totalAssets increases dramatically while totalSupply remains 1

attack_steps.action: Victim executes deposit(amount). convertToShares rounds down to 0 or 1 share.
attack_steps.expected_state_delta: victim gets 0 shares or severely diluted shares

attack_steps.action: Attacker redeems their initial share, receiving their donation plus victim's assets.
